---
title: "大学樹木マップ"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"
          integrity="sha256-p4NxAoJBhIINfQpGD1ZYNnrbB2JYjtmI3QDQ1e7W28="
          crossorigin="">
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"
          integrity="sha256-20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo="
          crossorigin=""></script>
        <script src="assets/map.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<main class="tree-map-shell">
  <section class="tree-map-header" aria-label="公開データの概要">
    <div>
      <p class="eyebrow">Campus Tree Inventory</p>
      <h1>大学樹木マップ</h1>
      <p class="lead">Garmin GPSMAPで記録したキャンパス内の樹木位置と樹種名を公開しています。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="status-strip" aria-live="polite">
      <span><strong id="tree-count">0</strong> 本</span>
      <span id="last-updated">更新確認中</span>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="tree-map-toolbar" aria-label="樹木検索">
    <label class="field">
      <span>検索</span>
      <input id="tree-search" type="search" placeholder="樹種名・学名・ID" autocomplete="off">
    </label>
    <label class="field">
      <span>樹種</span>
      <select id="species-filter">
        <option value="">すべて</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <div class="download-links" aria-label="データダウンロード">
      <a href="data/public/trees.csv">CSV</a>
      <a href="data/public/trees.geojson">GeoJSON</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="tree-map-grid">
    <div id="map" class="map-canvas" aria-label="樹木位置図"></div>
    <aside class="tree-panel" aria-label="樹木一覧">
      <div class="panel-section">
        <h2>凡例</h2>
        <div id="legend" class="legend"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="panel-section table-section">
        <h2>一覧</h2>
        <div class="table-wrap">
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>ID</th>
                <th>樹種</th>
                <th>学名</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="tree-table-body"></tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </section>
</main>
```
